resources.string: IoT Based App Monitoring System for AquaGuard Storage and Filtration System

Information Collection and Use
Our IoT Monitoring Service may collect personally identifiable information from Users in a variety of ways, including, but not limited to, when Users visit our site, register on the site, place an order, subscribe to the newsletter, respond to a survey, fill out a form, and in connection with other activities, services, features or resources we make available. Users may be asked for, as appropriate, name, email address, mailing address, phone number, and other information.
We will collect personal identification information from Users only if they voluntarily submit such information to us. Users can always refuse to supply personally identification information, except that it may prevent them from engaging in certain Site related activities.
